_about: One real source per category in the original set, all DISABLED; further news and trade sources were added later, also all DISABLED with review_required. Robots notes were checked by hand on the date each one records (2026-09-22 for the original six, 2026-10-10 for those added later, 2026-10-11 for the two hosting seeds); terms must be re-verified by a person before a source is enabled (PATCH enabled: true). Seeding never overwrites or enables an existing source.

sources.name: GOV.UK news and announcements
sources.robots_note: robots.txt checked 2026-10-10: User-agent * disallows /*/print$ and /search/all*; the .atom feed at /search/news-and-communications.atom matches neither, so it is allowed. No crawl-delay for *.
sources.terms_note: Open Government Licence v3.0 (https://www.nationalarchives.gov.uk/doc/open-government-licence/version/3/): copy, publish, distribute and exploit commercially, with acknowledgement and, where possible, a link to the licence. Credit the provider's attribution statement where given, otherwise the fallback 'Contains public sector information licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0.' No implied official status or endorsement. Store titles, links and short summaries only; never full text or images; drop items marked 'except where otherwise stated' (third-party rights, logos, personal data). Re-verify before enabling.
sources.license_note: Contains public sector information licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0 (https://www.nationalarchives.gov.uk/doc/open-government-licence/version/3/).

sources.name: NOAA news
sources.robots_note: robots.txt checked 2026-10-10: https://www.noaa.gov/robots.txt answers 403 to our identifying User-Agent (NOAA's CDN blocks bot UAs on HTML paths), so its rules could not be read; the FEED https://www.noaa.gov/rss.xml itself answers 200/application/rss+xml to our identifying UA. Resolve the robots/User-Agent 403 with NOAA before enabling.
sources.terms_note: Most NOAA information is in the US public domain and may be used with credit; third-party-credited items, images and video are excluded, and use must not imply US-Government endorsement or affiliation. Credit 'NOAA' (National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration) and link back. Store titles, links and short summaries only; never full text or images. Re-verify before enabling.
sources.license_note: US federal government work (public domain) with per-item credits; credit NOAA.

sources.name: Frankfurter euro reference rates
sources.robots_note: robots.txt checked 2026-10-10: https://frankfurter.dev/robots.txt and https://api.frankfurter.dev/robots.txt both say User-agent * Allow /; the /v2/rates path is allowed. No crawl-delay.
sources.terms_note: Frankfurter is MIT-licensed software, free for commercial use, with no API key and no quota (only anti-abuse rate limiting). The rates themselves fall under each provider's terms, so attribute the contributing provider (ECB, TCMB, ...) and link https://frankfurter.dev/ and the provider's terms; for ECB-sourced rates cite 'European Central Bank'. The legacy object endpoint https://api.frankfurter.app/latest cannot be mapped by the api adapter (it requires an array at items_path), so the array endpoint https://api.frankfurter.dev/v2/rates is used and each row (date, base, quote, rate) becomes one item. Rates are informational observations only, never advice (ADR-025). Re-verify before enabling.
sources.license_note: Frankfurter software: MIT. Underlying rates: per provider (ECB reference rates reusable with attribution); see https://frankfurter.dev/license/.

sources.name: Vultr cloud plans
sources.robots_note: robots.txt checked 2026-10-11: https://api.vultr.com/robots.txt is exactly 'User-agent: *' followed by 'Disallow: /', which disallows every path on the API host. The fetcher re-checks robots.txt on every run and would refuse /v2/plans as disallowed, so this source cannot be enabled as written — an operator must resolve the robots.txt block with Vultr first. (The endpoint itself answers without an API key.)
sources.terms_note: Vultr's API documentation says the plans listing needs no API key for ordinary accounts ('If your account has special plans available, you will need to pass your API key ... For all other accounts, the API key is not required'), and the official govultr client documents that 'public operations like listing plans ... will still work' unauthenticated; /v2/plans answered with plan data to our keyless fetcher. www.vultr.com/api/ and www.vultr.com/legal/tos/ both answered 403 to our fetcher, so Vultr's API terms could not be read here and must be read by a person before enabling. Attribute Vultr by linking https://www.vultr.com/pricing/; show each price as an observation 'checked on <date>', never a current price, and imply no endorsement. Re-verify before enabling.
sources.license_note: Plan specifications and prices are Vultr's data (https://www.vultr.com/pricing/); Vultr's terms pages could not be fetched (HTTP 403 to our fetcher) and no licence to republish them was found. Attribute Vultr and link the pricing page; no endorsement implied.

sources.name: Akamai Cloud (Linode) plan types
sources.robots_note: robots.txt checked 2026-10-11: https://api.linode.com/robots.txt answers 301 to https://api.linode.com/v4/, which answers 404 (a JSON 'Not found'), so the API host publishes no robots.txt rules; a 404 is treated as no restrictions (never guessed as a disallow), so /v4/linode/types is allowed. The fetcher re-checks robots.txt on every run.
sources.terms_note: Akamai's Linode API documentation says 'Some of this API's operations are publicly accessible and don't require authentication'; /v4/linode/types answered with type data to our keyless fetcher. https://www.linode.com/legal-tos/ answers 404 and https://www.linode.com/legal redirects to https://www.akamai.com/legal, where the governing documents are Akamai's Acceptable Use Policy and the Akamai Cloud (Linode) Master Services Agreement; none of those pages states a right to, or a clear ban on, republishing plan or price data (the AUP forbids using the network to build a competitive service and IP infringement), so a person must read them before enabling. Attribute Akamai/Linode by linking https://www.linode.com/pricing/; show each price as an observation 'checked on <date>', never a current price, and imply no endorsement. Re-verify before enabling.
sources.license_note: Plan specifications and prices are Akamai/Linode's data (https://www.linode.com/pricing/); the terms hub is https://www.akamai.com/legal. No licence to republish them was found. Attribute Akamai/Linode and link the pricing page; no endorsement implied.

sources.name: Amazon Lightsail instance bundles (US East, N. Virginia)
sources.robots_note: robots.txt checked 2026-10-12: https://pricing.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/robots.txt answers 404 (an S3 NoSuchKey error), so the price list host publishes no robots.txt rules; a 404 is treated as no restrictions (never guessed as a disallow). The fetcher re-checks robots.txt on every run.
sources.terms_note: This is the AWS Price List bulk API, AWS's documented keyless way to read its prices by program. Every file carries its own disclaimer: 'This pricing list is for informational purposes only. All prices are subject to the additional terms included in the pricing pages on http://aws.amazon.com.' Show each price as an observation 'checked on <date>' with a link to https://aws.amazon.com/lightsail/pricing/, never as a quote, and imply no endorsement. One file (about 230 KB) a day. Re-verify before enabling.
sources.license_note: Prices and bundle specifications are Amazon Web Services' data. No licence to republish them was found beyond the informational disclaimer above. Attribute AWS and link the Lightsail pricing page.
